credential.title: Payment Credential
credential.description: Credential to tokenize. Handlers define accepted credential types in their specification.

type.description: The credential type discriminator. Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: Binding context that ties this token to a specific checkout and participant identity.

checkout_id.description: The checkout session identifier this token is bound to.

identity.title: Payment Identity
identity.description: The participant this token is bound to. Required when acting on behalf of another participant (e.g., agent tokenizing for merchant). Omit when the authenticated caller is the binding target.

access_token.description: Unique identifier for this participant, obtained during onboarding with the tokenizer.
